lines.zh: 我在水里划着桨一样的鳍。
lines.en: I row with fin-like flaps through the water.
I swim along the seabed, slowly.
The flaps along my sides ripple in sequence.
I slide between the reef rocks.

lines.zh: 冷水流过我的腮，很舒服。
lines.en: Cold water runs over my gills. Pleasant.
I arch my back and skim the sand.

lines.zh: 我一直朝更深的地方走。
lines.en: I keep heading deeper.
I glance back at the surface.

lines.zh: 我的影子投在海底，很长。
lines.en: My shadow lies long on the floor.
Mouth open, I sieve the water as I go.

lines.zh: 我顺着寒流游出去一段。
lines.en: I ride the cold current out a stretch.
I rise, then sink again.
I stop in the shallows and wait.
My tail fan stirs up a cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地蠕动前进。
lines.en: I inch forward, segment by segment.
I hang in the water, flaps still moving.
This shell of mine is harder than stone.

lines.zh: 前面的两只爪子，是我的。
lines.en: Those two claws up front are mine.

lines.zh: 我在等什么东西游过来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something to swim by.
There's little to see in the cold sea.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是复眼，看得很广。
lines.en: My compound eyes see very wide.
I press to a rock like a plate.
I listen to the tremors in the water.
I know this stretch of seabed.
I'm in no hurry to find food.
My mouthparts open and close.
The deep is dark; I need no light.

lines.zh: 我扭了一下身子，沙落下来。
lines.en: I twist; sand falls off me.
You're up at the surface. I see you.
You've come in. Good.
Your shell isn't as good as mine.
These two claws can crush shells.
You're inside my shadow above.
You swim slowly.
I'm not hospitable here.

lines.zh: 你的光在水里晃得厉害。
lines.en: Your light wavers badly down here.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，像看一块肉。
lines.en: I look up at you like a piece of meat.
Don't touch my seabed.
A mark is left on my shell.
I writhe; sand flies up.
That drove me back.
The smell of blood spreads in the water.
I make no cry; no one hears underwater.

lines.zh: 甲壳被敲了一下，往下沉。
lines.en: Something strikes my shell and I sink lower.
One of my flaps has stopped.
My fin split; I swim crooked.
You hit a seam.
My shell can take this little damage.
I won't touch what you're holding.

lines.zh: 水里的小东西才合我胃口。
lines.en: Small creatures in the water suit me.
Why are you waving that?
I'm not hungry. I'm guarding.
Your hand is in the water. Don't blame me.

lines.zh: 收回去，那是活的东西吗？
lines.en: Put it back. Is it alive?
I don't take risks for food.
That temptation is too shallow.
I don't shift, but the water churns.
My shell scraped you.
I swim off a little.
Don't press my back; the gills are there.
This body of mine won't break.
The water pushes us apart a little.

lines.zh: 你踩到海床，惊了我的猎物。
lines.en: You touched the seabed and scared my prey.

lines.zh: 碰一下，我知道你在哪儿。
lines.en: One touch and I know where you are.

lines.zh: 另一只也从深处上来了。
lines.en: Another one has risen from the deep too.
We row along side by side.
Its claws are smaller than mine.
We touch antennae.
The cold current comes; we travel together.
Between our kind there's nothing to contest.
It sinks first.

lines.zh: 水面上的光落在我们身上。
lines.en: The light from above falls on us.

lines.zh: 我们分开，各守一片海床。
lines.en: We part, each keeping a stretch.
Next cold current, perhaps again.
It sank to my feet.
I turn it over with a claw.
I press it into the sand.
The pearl is bright in the water.
I swim two circles holding it.
It sinks. I'll keep it.
I tuck it under a shell plate.
I keep what falls.
I loosen the claw and it drops.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I've caught your scent.
I raise both claws.
Any stir in the water tells me the way.
You're in my shadow now.
I'm in no hurry. I wait.
On this seabed there's only us.
Don't swim up; up won't help.
I open my mouthparts.
You can see me, but not clearly.
Locked on. Just this once.
I'll come in from the side.
You're on the reef; I circle it.
I wait for you to come down.
I move while you take breath.
My compound eyes stay on you.
The water pushes you toward me.
Touch the sand and the sand moves.
I swim slowly, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 你退到石缝里，我进不去。
lines.en: You back into a crevice I can't enter.
I'll wait right outside it.
The water cools and your limbs slow.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的钳就够到了。
lines.en: A little closer and my claws reach.
I clamp my claw on your calf.
That clamp warps your armor.
My mouthparts snap together.
You pull free; my claw comes away sandy.

lines.zh: 奇虾的螯肢，从深海伸上来。
lines.en: My great appendages rise from the deep.
The water clouds with that hit.
Your sleeve is torn open.
I don't open my claw.

lines.zh: 你挣扎得越厉害，我夹得越紧。
lines.en: The more you struggle, the tighter I hold.
I drag you deeper.
I sweep you aside with my tail.

lines.zh: 我从海床的沙里拱出来。
lines.en: I push up out of the seabed sand.

lines.zh: 寒流把我的影子送进来。
lines.en: The cold current carries my shadow in.
One more shell in the deep.
I rise; sand slides off my back.
This sea is cold enough.
First I open both claws.
There's light above. I avoid it.
I slide down the reef wall.
A school of small fish flees first.
I settle on this stretch of floor.

lines.zh: 我以前住在更冷的地方。
lines.en: I used to live in colder water.
Old mud clings to my shell.
I taste the water and learn the place.

lines.zh: 礁石下面有个洞，我进去。
lines.en: There's a hollow under the reef; I go in.
Fire is useless here; only steam.

lines.zh: 我落到海床上，甲震了一下。
lines.en: I hit the seabed and my shell jolts.

lines.zh: 爆开的水把我推得翻过去。
lines.en: The blast wave flips me over.
An arrow lodges in a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 水里亮起一片光，我缩了。
lines.en: Light blooms in the water; I curl up.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我动得慢了。
lines.en: Too long without food; I slow.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整个麻了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and numbs me whole.
I fall, and the water is gone.
